title: Keynote Presentation: The Texas Smackover: America's Lithium Leviathan
gist: Member-only listing for a 7-minute Benchmark Summit 2026 London keynote by Galvanic Energy President and CFO Jeremy Humphers, billing the Texas Smackover as 'America's Lithium Leviathan', with tags for USA and DLE. No resource or project figures are disclosed.

insights.claim: Galvanic Energy President and CFO Jeremy Humphers billed the Texas Smackover as 'America's Lithium Leviathan' in a keynote at Benchmark Summit 2026 London, presenting it as a very large US lithium resource.
insights.speaker: Jeremy Humphers , President and CFO , Galvanic Energy
insights.so_what: The Texas Smackover is being promoted as a major US domestic lithium source; track Galvanic Energy and basin developments.
insights.quote: The Texas Smackover: America's Lithium Leviathan

insights.claim: The Galvanic Energy Texas Smackover keynote was tagged DLE, which points to direct lithium extraction as the intended production route for Texas Smackover brine.
insights.speaker: Jeremy Humphers , President and CFO , Galvanic Energy
insights.so_what: Texas Smackover value depends on DLE performing at commercial scale.

insights.claim: Galvanic Energy's Texas Smackover keynote ran 7:24 and was presented by its President and CFO rather than a technical lead, which suggests a capital-markets-oriented pitch.
